description: A candid black-and-white square snapshot capturing a man in a sun hat, t-shirt, and swim shorts reclining on a beach towel alongside a young girl lying on her stomach in the sand. Taken in August 1970 at Balboa Island in Newport Beach, California, and processed in October 1970, the scene conveys a relaxed mid-century family vacation vibe, complete with sun umbrellas and other beachgoers visible along the seawall in the background.
